name: The Jain Education Society
description: The Jain Education Society (JES), Mumbai, founded in 1943 by Shri Chimanbhai Chakubhai Shah and Shri Durlabhjibhai Khetani, aimed to support bright students from Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra in pursuing higher education. JES provided hostel accommodation, scholarships, and financial assistance, benefiting approximately 4,000 students. As a pre-independence charitable organization, JES has made significant contributions to Jain community education. It ran a Gujarati Medium School at Chirabazar, Mumbai, for over 30 years and currently operates three boys' hostels, a school in Rajkot, and various educational assistance programs. JES plays a vital role in nation-building by fostering educated, resourceful, and successful students

featured_reviews.name: Keshowar Jahan
featured_reviews.review_text: I enrolled my daughter in birla brainiacs on the 2nd standard,now she is in 5th grade. Teachers are really good. All the study material and class recording available on the app. The admission process is really easy as staff are really helpful particularly Babli Biswas ,she helped us since my first inquiry.

featured_reviews.name: Niharika K
featured_reviews.review_text: My son is studying in 4th grade in Birla brainiacs. Classes are okay. The main problem is their sales team and their mis guidance to the parents. Ms Ojaswini is the sales person. She informed us that they can have batch c for cbsc curriculum and she send me screenshot to select books for the same. I paid 5k extra for books but when the classes started we came to know that only IG syllabus is available at that slot. When we check with the person in charge, he was like, you guys selected. They are cheating people for admission and misguiding parents and playing with kids future which Is not at all acceptable. I am attaching screenshot as well where she guided us. They can tell truth that only cbsc is in morning section then we won't opt for this school but they misguided us and make our money also wanted.

featured_reviews.name: Avanteeka Bakshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very very poor orientation experience. This is the second time I tried to get in touch with them. Last year it totally was a fiascos with Miss Ojaswini. Again i called them and she was the point of contact, who apparently handles all the admission. I find her  absolutely unqualified to deal with the very first step when you are considering the admission. She she talks to you like a sales person. She has no idea how to handle an academic conversation, how to share details on an academic process  and is only selling and pitching in a hurry with half baked details.
If this is the experience at the time of enquiry and trying and knowing the system, can you imagine what will happen when your child actually joins? It’ll be total chaos, and you will be left at the mercy of non academic or not qualified for this process   dear parents, please be smart and choose wisely, and if Birlabrainiacs management is seeing this, please get more qualified people who actually know how to handle academic conversations and parents enquiries and not pure sales profiles.
